transcript.content: Hello, welcome. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

Well... I guess I just don't really feel like myself anymore. I don't know. I barely talk to anyone these days. I just kind of... go flat. Quiet. Even at work... getting started on my cleaning route, it just feels like pushing a loaded cart uphill. So... that's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days lately?

I suppose... yeah. Pretty much ever since I moved. It's just... always kind of sitting there in the background. Feeling sad, I guess. No energy. Feeling guilty about things... not really caring about much anymore. 

It doesn't really leave. Even on the days when... well, when other things are taking up my mind. Like... when I get caught up worrying about the cameras... or, you know, hearing the voices. Even when that stuff is worse, that... down feeling is still just there underneath it all.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you once liked?

Yeah... I suppose. I don't really do much of anything anymore. 

I used to go out fishing on Saturdays... or just sit and do the crosswords with a cup of coffee. Even at work, I used to like showing the younger guys the right way to strip a floor. But... I don't know. I mostly just let all that sit now. It just doesn't give me anything back anymore. So I don't bother.
How long have you been feeling this way most days? Has it been at least two years, or is it something that started more recently, like within the past year or so?
I guess... it's been a little over a year. Maybe a year and two months, give or take. It started pretty soon after I moved. It hasn't really let up since then.
Have you ever had a period where you felt down or depressed for two years or more without much relief?
No... like I just said, it's only been about a year and two months. Just since I moved. Not two years.
Have there been any times during this past year when your low mood became so intense that it felt like a major depression, even if only for a few weeks?

I don't know about major... it's just always there. Pretty much most of the time since I moved. 

Just... feeling down. No energy. Feeling bad about things, not caring about much. It just sits in the background. Even on the days when... well, when I'm more caught up with the voices... or worrying about the cameras. The sadness is still just... there.
Has there been a time when something good happened, like a small success or a nice moment, and you still felt just as down as usual, without any real improvement in your mood?
I don't know... I mean, I guess so. Sometimes things are fine, but... it doesn't really change how I feel. It's just... it's just the same.
Have there been any periods, even just a few days long, when you felt significantly better or noticed a real improvement in your mood during the past year?

I guess... there was a stretch of a few weeks where it lifted some. I got through work and my meals a little better. But... it didn't change the other things. I still heard my name in the stairwell when I was cleaning. And... I still knew those hallway cameras were tracking me. So... I felt a little better, but that stuff was still happening.

Can you describe how your mood has been over the past two years? Specifically, have you had any long stretches where you felt better for a few months or more, or has it mostly been a constant low mood without much relief?

I don't know about two years. It hasn't been that long. 

I guess... the down feeling, the part where everything is just heavy... it's been about a year and two months. It started pretty soon after I moved. It hasn't really stopped since then. Just that one little break I mentioned. But mostly... it's just been there since the move.

Have there ever been times when your mood was unusually high, or you felt unusually energetic or irritable for several days in a row, where you didn’t feel like you needed much sleep or found yourself doing things that were out of character for you?
No. I haven't had anything like that. Just... just the heavy feeling. I sleep normal, mostly. I don't get energetic.
